caption:
One short letter. And one thing left in your hands. (Galatians — the closing word)

Fifty-four steps through Galatians, and it all comes down to a single line: Christ set you free, so stand firm in that freedom and add nothing to His finished work. If only one thing stays with you from the whole letter, let it be this — grace in Christ is enough. Thank you for walking all of Galatians with us.
